name: Stormbringer: Shock and Aeroblast scale with spell power, and Master Elementalist raises it (#12968)
contract: #12968: Master Elementalist 705662 reads 'Increases the spell damage scaling of Shock by $s1% and Aeroblast
by $s2%' and is two aura 107 SPELLMOD_BONUS_MULTIPLIER effects, +10 on Shock's mask and +20 on Aeroblast's,
so +0.10 and +0.20 spell power coefficient. Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone only applies that modifier when the
spell already has a coefficient, and Shock (804020, 503326-503332, 504634) and Aeroblast (801839) had none:
no spell_bonus_data row, Shock's client EffectBonusMultiplier is 0 and Aeroblast's is cleared at load. Their
fix adds 0.55 and 0.635 rows, makes Shock read the higher of Arcane and Nature spell power, and lifts the
stock level penalty on Aeroblast, whose only rank is a level 13 spell (the tooltip has no penalty).
spell_damage_done is the native outgoing calculation on a 1000 base, so each value is a ratio to the same
player's query without spell power, which cancels class damage modifiers: +2000 spell power (44505) gives
Shock rank 9 (504634) 2.10 and Aeroblast 2.27; +200 Arcane only (24544) gives Shock 1.11 and +66 Nature only
(38305, nothing else on the spell) gives 1.0363, so neither school alone can satisfy both; after learning
Master Elementalist, +2000 gives Shock 2.30 and Aeroblast 2.67. Bands are 0.5%. Before the fix every ratio

DISCRIMINATING: Aeroblast gains 0.635 per spell power
